links.outcome: Moral reasoning accuracy of LLMs after prolonged negative narrative exposure versus baseline
links.effect: Negative narrative exposure degraded moral accuracy across multiple LLMs, with average drops of 12%-31%, worse in ambiguous scenarios and those involving vulnerable individuals; first-person narratives had stronger effects.
links.quote: First, negative narrative exposure degrades moral accuracy across multiple LLMs, with average drops of 12%-31%, especially in ambiguous scenarios and those involving vulnerable individuals.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM safety and moral reasoning degradation under prolonged negative narrative exposure across multiple domains including counseling and medical scenarios.
